repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
**Elasticsearch version** (`bin/elasticsearch --version`): 7.11.1 but still present in `master`

**Description of the problem including expected versus actual behavior**:

This code ...

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/a92a647b9f17d1bddf5c707490a19482c273eda3/x-pack/plugin/core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/core/DataTiersUsageTransportAction.java#L103-L111

... assumes that if any shards of an index are assigned to a `RoutingNode` then the node will have reported stats for this index. This isn't always true, because the assignment according to the cluster state might not match the assignment on the node at the time it computed its stats.

Relates #63031

issue.title: Check shard availability before including in stats

labels.name: Team:Data Management (obsolete)
labels.description: DO NOT USE. This team no longer exists.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
With this commit we check whether there is an available shard routing before we test whether it has been started. This makes `DataTiersUsageTransportAction` more resilient to potential temporary inconsistencies between cluster state and node stats due to concurrent shard movement.

Closes #87001
Closes #96000
